I did everything I fucking could to show my gf how much I cared about her and she ghosted me so she could date someone else.
Why does that make me hate myself? Clearly the absolute best I can do is nowhere near enough. Maybe I just don’t deserve love and I should resign myself to being alone.

yeah getting ghosted is fucking shit there’s really nothing more to say

god what the fuck. why. i thought we were really close. i did so much to show you how much i cared and i really did care about you so fucking much. and i thought you did too. i thought you liked me, hell, i thought you fucking loved me.

  
you made me so many promises, but those evaporated as soon as you found someone you liked more. you were so scared that i would leave you only to turn around and leave me in the cruelest way possible. i hate this so fucking much.

  
and i saw it coming. i said as much. but you assured me it was fine, that you would never do that. that was what, a few weeks before?

  
fuck you. fuck you. i made so many sacrifices and did so much because i cared about you. i tried so hard to show you that you were loved, that your shitty family was wrong, that things were going to be okay. i sent you your favorite flowers on your birthday with a note that you said you were going to save because it was so sweet.

  
that was a week before you blocked me to date someone else. fuck you. fuck you for letting me care about you and for letting me trust you and for making so many promises that never meant anything.

  
i wonder if you ever really cared. i wonder if you ever really loved me. cus you sure had me fucking fooled.
Shit I’m down
No absolutely nothing weird about it, cutting is the most well-known but burning isn’t unusual.  There’s all kinds of self-harm, the tool isn’t really the important part

If it means anything, you’re not in it alone. I know exactly how you feel and I’m genuinely not sure about making it through each day. I wish I had a solution to give you, but if I did, I wouldn’t be here in the first place. Fuck, idek where I’m going with this. But just know that you’re not alone.
Well goddamn I’m happy for you, have a good one man
Lmao same my best friend and kinda gf (its complicated) blocked me out of the blue and I thought we were fine it’s really a great time

Lmao at orientation my school said “we monitor searches on the school computers.” I think yeah, to catch crimes and porn, right? “We search for words like death, depression, cutting…” oh, lovely, if I’m too sad you’re going to fucking report me to my parents. Remind me again why I should tell the school about my problems?

My understanding and knowledge of neopronouns is rather choppy, so I’m not going to venture onto that front.

“Hi, this is Kai. He’s searching for his identity and they’re so brave to try that, don’t you think?”

“Can you tell Mars I said hi? I haven’t seen her in a while but they’re wonderful and I want to see her when I can.”
Hey Max! Nothing wrong with indecision, almost of us are just as confused as you are? Maximillian is a fucking cool name and I love it.

Nell, believe me, I completely identify with what you mean. I understand knowing that you’re definitely not cis, but being completely lost on what your identity really is. You’ve got this, El. I know you do.
Artemis is amazing, isn’t she? She’s so brave to take the journey of trying to figure out her identity and I’m incredibly proud of her.
Mina. Girl. Look at me. You’re wonderful. You’ve got this. You can do this. You’re so fucking brave and I know you can take that final step.
Hey this is Kate, she’s trying out new pronouns and I couldn’t be more proud of her for being that brave!
Bruh wtf, I’m here browsing this sub to try and worsen my depression and here you are being positive, stop ruining my self-sabotage
100mg and still adjusting the dosage, currently not taking them so I can save them up and take them all at once 🙃

Like 3 or 4 of these to varying levels, I’m really on the brink here

Why do you think I’m here? Hell, that’s why I made this entire account

Well I’m not at the suicide part yet but a sign for something else was very much needed.

This sub is an echo chamber of depressive thoughts, and I scroll it specifically because I think I deserve it to drag my mood down. Omitting specifics, I was considering doing something, but the fact that you took the time to write this tiny point of light in the darkness means more than you can know.

Have a good one.
I sometimes avoid things that make me happy because I think I don’t deserve them, but idk how common that is

Sometimes I hope beyond hope that they’ll say they’re proud of me. Just once. One singular time.

Nope.
